prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1109; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss for side impact collision at intersection. Insured reports being struck on driver side by another vehicle that entered on a red signal. Scene photos requested from insured. Claimant reported knee injury at scene and later represented by counsel; letter of representation received, all contact to go through attorney's office.

Entry 2: Spoke with insured's counsel regarding liability. Insured's account consistent with initial report. Police report requested and pending. Reviewed traffic camera footage obtained from nearby business; signal phase appears to support insured's statement. Liability position under review, no admission made at this time.

Entry 3: Received medical authorization and records request from claimant's attorney. Treating provider notes indicate knee injury with ongoing physical therapy. Requested full treatment history and imaging reports before evaluating bodily injury component. Advised counsel that all future correspondence should be routed through office.

Entry 4: Vehicle damage assessment completed. Passenger-side door, rear quarter panel and frame intersection damage noted. Repair estimate received from body shop and under review. Rental coverage confirmed for insured. Claimant's vehicle inspected separately; damage consistent with reported point of impact.

Entry 5: Follow-up call with claimant's attorney regarding status of medical records. Attorney indicated treatment is ongoing and a demand package will follow once care plateaus. Reserves reviewed and adjusted for potential bodily injury exposure. File diary set for review in thirty days pending receipt of records and police report.
